hints.title: English Alphabet Completeness
hints.text: A pangram sentence must contain all 26 distinct lowercase letters from a to z.

hints.title: Distinct Character Count
hints.text: Collecting characters into a lookup set determines the count of unique letters.

hints.title: Check Cardinality
hints.text: Return whether the count of distinct letters in the set equals 26.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the sentence 26 times takes O(26 * n) instead of a single linear pass.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A fixed size 26-bit integer or set checks character presence in O(n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks uniqueness and alphabet cardinality cleanly.
